payload.reason: The evidence indicates that not applying RR-based fingerprint construction can lead to increased overfitting and reduced signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), negatively impacting detection performance.

claims.text: Not applying RR-based fingerprint construction can lead to overfitting, which reduces the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and predictive value.
Regularisation in RR improves SNR by reducing variability and enhancing the generalisability of the fingerprint.
Without RR, the model may produce unphysical coefficient fingerprints, which can obscure true signal detection.
